U=U

An important fact

Undetectable = Untransmittable.

ART can reduce HIV in the blood to levels that standard viral load tests cannot detect. When a person is on effective treatment and maintains an undetectable viral load, they do not sexually transmit HIV to their partners.

U=U is not only important for prevention. Understanding the science can also challenge fear and reduce stigma.

Learn about U=U

Myths & Facts

Misinformation can create distance where none is needed.

Myth

HIV can be transmitted through hugging.

Fact

HIV is not transmitted through everyday social contact such as hugging or sharing food.

Why can this myth be harmful?

Misunderstanding transmission can cause people to be avoided or treated differently for no medical reason.

Information you can trace

Evidence is not an afterthought.

Major educational pages name their sources, review status and latest review date so readers can assess where the information comes from.

  • Indonesian sources

    Indonesia’s Ministry of Health and official health authorities for national policy, guidance and local context.

  • International sources

    WHO and UNAIDS for HIV basics, treatment, prevention, U=U, stigma and rights.

  • Scientific literature

    Peer-reviewed research when behavioural, communication, stigma or public-health questions need further context.

About Ruang Tanpa Stigma

HIV information should be understandable without making anyone feel judged.

This initiative develops HIV education, treatment literacy, supportive communication and stigma-reduction resources for people in Indonesia. Ruang Tanpa Stigma is new and will report its process, learning and results honestly.

About the initiativeHow we will measure progress
Working principles

Evidence for traceable information.

Empathy for human conversations.

Dignity because health status does not determine worth.

Transparency so plans are never presented as results.
